policy: Physically rehash every complete measurement, package, artifact, grid, scoring image and tool pin. Preserve the predeclared source, exact unresized pixels and durable attempt budget, including failures and interruptions. Compare separate nondominated metric frontiers using quarter-unit brackets and log-byte interpolation without extrapolation. Unmeasured or unresolved bands stay null. Frozen source snapshots preserve historical peer qualification across later first-party codec changes. This verifier reuses qualified pixels; it performs no fresh encode or decode and makes no universal compression claim.
